column1: # hub actions: id <TAB> group <TAB> title <TAB> keys <TAB> kind <TAB> command <TAB> state <TAB> needs <TAB> desc
# Columns and kinds are documented at the top of ~/.config/hub/hub. `-` = empty, trailing columns may be omitted.
# Later stages append rows here (or drop a *.tsv into actions.d/). Rows whose command/needs is not installed are hidden.
# Every described Hyprland bind is imported live in addition to these rows; matching titles/keys are merged.

column3: Idle: dim, clock screensaver, panel off (hypridle)
column9: ON = hypridle runs (screen dims, clock screensaver, panel off). The machine never suspends or locks by itself.
ON = notifications are paused and collect in the history.

column6: nmcli radio wifi "$(nmcli radio wifi | grep -q "^enabled" && echo off || echo on)"
bluetoothctl power "$(bluetoothctl show | grep -q "Powered: yes" && echo off || echo on)"

column9: ON = every microphone is muted. Pressing again unmutes the default one only.
ON = the default output is muted.
Starts or stops a gpu-screen-recorder recording of the focused monitor.
Lock, suspend, logout, reboot, poweroff.
Saved to ~/pics/screenshots and copied.
Targets the window that was focused before the hub opened.
The screen freezes at the key press; select the region on the frozen image (Esc cancels and unfreezes). Saved to ~/pics/screenshots and copied.

column3: Screenshot: frozen screen, region, then annotate (satty)

column9: Enter pastes into the previous window, Alt+Enter / y only copies, Alt+p / m pins, Alt+d / d deletes, Alt+i / f images only, Alt+t / t text only. The preview pane shows the text or the image.
Enter types the emoji into the previous window, Alt+Enter / y copies it. Recently used come first.
Newest first with a preview; Enter shows a notification again, Alt+d / d removes it from the history.
Float, pin, opacity, move, screenshot, copy class, close, kill... on the window that was focused before the hub opened.
The preview shows the window details and its app icon.

column3: App launcher (rofi: Ctrl+j/k move, Ctrl+d/u page, Esc cancel)

column9: Arch news, yay -Syu, flatpak, pacnew, cache cleanup.
fzf over the VPN daemons present on this machine; asks for sudo.
journalctl -b piped into fzf.

column3: Wi-Fi / network (nmtui fallback, no vim keys)
column9: The classic NetworkManager text UI; the Wi-Fi picker (SUPER+I) is the daily driver.
Inside a git directory (tmux popup) it opens that repo, otherwise the dotfiles repo.
Read-only PASS/FAIL check of the approved workstation state.

column3: Health issues (failed and restarting units, alerts)
column9: The waybar health badge in detail: failed and restart-looping system/user units and the sysalert conditions, with systemctl status and the last 30 journal lines in the preview. Enter offers restart, stop, journal in less. Same data as the badge.

ON = full bar (drawers for toggles, network, audio, system and tray), OFF = compact bar (workspaces, clock, battery and alerts only). The icon at the right end of the bar does the same; right click on it opens the bar menu.
ON = the bar is hidden on every monitor (the mode is kept; the windows use the freed strip).
